notes: Battery version of the 2nd gen Nest Protect smoke and CO alarm.

gaps: Google's spec page gives no model number and does not say whether the batteries are user replaceable.
method: The spec page has separate Battery and Wired columns.

comps.spec: Six long-life batteries (Energizer Ultimate Lithium L91 AA)
2-watt speaker; horn sound output 85 dB SPL at 10 ft (3 m)
Split-Spectrum Sensor and 10-year electrochemical carbon monoxide sensor (10 years counted from date of manufacture)

sources.title: Google Nest Help: Nest Protect 2nd generation technical specifications
